mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(original_amount), 0) AS totalOriginalAmount, COALESCE(SUM(received_amount), 0) AS totalReceivedAmount, COALESCE(SUM(balance_amount), 0) AS totalBalanceAmount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS normalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS overdueCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 END) AS badDebtCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN 1 END) AS writtenOffCount FROM receivables WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(overdue_days, 0) = 0 THEN 'current' WHEN COALESCE(overdue_days, 0) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30' WHEN COALESCE(overdue_days, 0) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN '31-60' WHEN COALESCE(overdue_days, 0) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN '61-90' WHEN COALESCE(overdue_days, 0) > 90 THEN '90+' END AS agingBucket, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(balance_amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM receivables WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (1, 2) GROUP BY agingBucket ORDER BY agingBucket
